name: Push Day — Strength Focus
description: A comprehensive push day targeting chest, shoulders, and triceps. Follows progressive overload principles for strength and size.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.tips: Retract scapula, drive feet into floor, control eccentric for 3s

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.tips: 30-45° incline, elbows at 75°, full range of motion

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.tips: Keep slight elbow bend, squeeze at peak contraction

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.tips: Brace core, bar path slightly back over head, lock out elbows

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.tips: Lead with elbows, slight forward lean, controlled descent

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.tips: Elbows pinned to sides, spread rope at bottom, full extension

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.tips: Keep elbows close, lower slowly, feel the long head stretch

name: Pull Day — Hypertrophy Focus
description: A pull session designed for maximum lat width and bicep development. High volume with moderate loads.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-ups
exercises.tips: Full dead hang start, pull elbows to hips, chin over bar

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.tips: Hinge at hips, neutral spine, pull bar to lower sternum

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.tips: Drive elbows back past torso, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.tips: Brace on bench, row to hip, rotate torso slightly at top

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.tips: Cable at head height, pull to forehead, externally rotate at end

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.tips: Elbows fixed, supinate at top, control the negative

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.tips: Neutral grip, both arms alternating, no swinging

name: Leg Day — Complete Lower Body
description: A comprehensive leg session hitting all lower body muscle groups. Built around the squat as the primary movement.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.tips: Bar on traps, brace core hard, break parallel, drive knees out

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.tips: Hinge at hips, soft knee bend, bar drags down shins, feel hamstring stretch

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.tips: High foot placement for glutes/hams, don't lock knees at top

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.tips: Long stride, knee touches ground gently, torso upright

exercises.name: Leg Curl (Lying)
exercises.tips: Toes pointed, curl all the way, pause at top, slow descent

exercises.name: Calf Raises (Standing)
exercises.tips: Full range of motion, pause at bottom stretch, explosive up

name: Upper Body — Strength Day
description: Upper/Lower split — upper body strength session. Alternates push/pull patterns for balanced development.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.tips: Control the eccentric, full range, scapula retracted

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-ups
exercises.tips: Full hang, pull elbows to hips, controlled descent

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.tips: Standing, brace core, press bar overhead to lockout

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.tips: Bar starts on floor each rep, explosive pull, control down

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.tips: Arms hang fully extended, curl slowly, maximum stretch

exercises.name: Skull Crushers
exercises.tips: Lower bar to forehead level, elbows fixed, full extension

name: Lower Body — Hypertrophy Day
description: Upper/Lower split — lower body hypertrophy focus. Higher reps and more volume for muscle growth.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.tips: Dumbbell at chest, elbows inside knees, deep squat

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.tips: Dumbbells hang, hip hinge, feel hamstring load

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.tips: Shoulder blades on bench, drive hips up, squeeze glutes at top

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.tips: Control the descent, pause at full extension, 1s squeeze

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.tips: Full range, slow eccentric, pause at peak contraction

exercises.name: Calf Raises (Seated)
exercises.tips: Full stretch at bottom, slow and controlled, high volume

name: Full Body — Beginner Foundations
description: A 3x per week full body program for beginners. Focuses on mastering fundamental movement patterns with manageable loads.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.tips: Learn the squat pattern, feet shoulder-width, chest up

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.tips: Start light, find the groove, don't flare elbows

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.tips: Support yourself, pull elbow to ceiling, retract scapula

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.tips: Seated for stability, brace core, press straight up

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.tips: Hinge, don't squat, keep bar close to legs, neutral spine

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.tips: Neutral spine, squeeze glutes, breathe steadily

name: HIIT — Metabolic Conditioning
description: High-intensity interval training protocol. 40s work / 20s rest. Burns maximum calories in minimum time.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.tips: Full extension at top, chest to floor, explosive jump

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings
exercises.tips: Hip hinge power, not a squat, let bell float at top

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.tips: Soft knees, wrists drive the rope, stay on balls of feet

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.tips: Hips level, fast alternating drives, keep core tight

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.tips: Land softly with bent knees, step down (don't jump down)

exercises.name: Push-up to T Rotation
exercises.tips: Push up, rotate to side plank, reach arm up, alternate sides

name: HIIT — Bodyweight Blast
description: Zero equipment HIIT session. 30s work / 15s rest. Perfect for home workouts or travel.

exercises.name: Squat Jumps
exercises.tips: Land softly, absorb impact through hips and knees

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.tips: Straight body line, chest touches floor, full lockout

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.tips: Knees to hip height, arms pump, stay on toes

exercises.name: Tricep Dips (Chair)
exercises.tips: Hips close to chair, elbows go back not out, full range

exercises.name: Lateral Skaters
exercises.tips: Wide lateral bounds, touch floor lightly, drive off outside foot

exercises.name: Plank to Downdog
exercises.tips: Flow smoothly, push heels down in downdog, breathe

name: Morning Yoga Flow
description: A gentle morning yoga sequence to awaken the body, improve flexibility, and set a calm, focused tone for the day.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.tips: Arms extended, forehead on mat, breathe into lower back

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.tips: Slow rhythmic movement, sync with breath

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.tips: Pedal feet to stretch calves, push heels toward floor

exercises.name: Warrior I
exercises.tips: Front knee over ankle, back foot at 45°, hips square forward

exercises.name: Warrior II
exercises.tips: Hips open to side, arms parallel to floor, gaze over front hand

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
exercises.tips: Flex feet, hinge from hips not waist, hold shins or ankles

exercises.name: Supine Twist
exercises.tips: Shoulders stay flat, let gravity do the work, breathe deeply

name: Full Body Mobility & Recovery
description: A full-body mobility session combining foam rolling, dynamic stretching, and joint CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations). Ideal as active recovery.

exercises.name: Foam Roll Quads
exercises.tips: Pause on tender spots, rotate leg slightly to hit all angles

exercises.name: Foam Roll Thoracic Spine
exercises.tips: Arms crossed, pause at each thoracic segment, breathe into it

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 Stretch
exercises.tips: Both legs at 90°, sit tall, feel deep hip stretch

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.tips: Lunge, rotate elbow to floor, reach arm to ceiling, slow and controlled

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.tips: Arms straight, pull band to chest, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Ankle CARs
exercises.tips: Full range circles, slow and deliberate, maximize range

exercises.name: Doorframe Chest Stretch
exercises.tips: Arm at 90°, step through doorway, feel chest open
